overall_notes: The paper focuses on safety evaluation of LLM responses in Indonesian languages. It generates responses to safety-critical prompts and evaluates them using both automatic metrics (unsafe response rate) and LLM-as-judge (GPT-4o). Human evaluation was primarily for dataset quality verification rather than output evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some consolidation and normalization.
